before.story: Voting Extended in Brazil Runoff Amid Bus Shortages
before.summary: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court extended nationwide runoff voting by two hours to 7 p.m. and the Superior Electoral Court paused vote counting after severe bus cuts in Salvador prompted an arrest order for transport secretary Pablo Souza. With polls closed for nearly 160 million voters, early returns show Senator Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly leading incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

after.story: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva Wins Re-Election in Brazil Runoff
